CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
April 12, 2022 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
80TH BIRTHDAY RECOGNITION - It is recommended the City Council present Edward Massey with an 80th birthday recognition certificate.
5.1 80th Birthday Recognition
5.2
RECOGNITION OF MIKES CLASSIC BURGERS - It is recommended the City Council present Michael Christoforakis with a Certificate of Recognition and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
5.2 Recognition of Mikes Classic Burgers
5.3
PROCLAMATION FOR DONATE LIFE MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim April 2022 as Donate Life Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to OneLegacy Ambassador Mona Castro.
5.3 Proclamation for Donate Life Month
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of March 22, 2022.
7.1 Minutes of 3-22-22 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated April 12, 2022 in the total amount of $3,732,694.09.
7.2 Warrant Register
7.3
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE SMART TECHNOLOGY WASTE STATIONS FOR VARIOUS BUS STOP LOCATIONS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of 12 Bigbelly smart waste stations at a cost not to exceed $85,539.75.
7.3 Smart Technology Waste Stations
7.4
COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT BETWEEN COUNTY OF ORANGE AND CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR FUNDING AND CONSTRUCTION OF COYOTE CREEK CHANNEL CLASS 1 BIKEWAY (OC LOOP SEGMENT P) - It is recommended the City Council approve the Cooperative Agreement between County of Orange and City of La Mirada for Funding and Construction of Coyote Creek Channel Class 1 Bikeway (OC Loop Segment P).
7.4 Cooperative Agreement with County of Orange
7.5
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE A NEW REHEARSAL HALL RISER PLATFORM SYSTEM - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of a StageTek stage riser platform system from Wenger Corp. at a cost not to exceed $33,432.41.
7.5 Rehearsal Hall Riser Platform System
7.6
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING JANUARY 2022 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending January 2022.
7.6 Monthly Treasurer Report
7.7
SINGLE AUDIT REPORT FISCAL YEAR 2020-21 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Single Audit Report for Fiscal Year 2020-21.
7.7 Single Audit Report
7.8
APPROVAL OF USE OF FACILITY – LA MIRADA CHAMBER OF COMMERCE CANDIDATE FORUMS AT THE ACTIVITY CENTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the request from the La Mirada Chamber of Commerce for the use of the La Mirada Activity Center for Candidate Forums.
7.8 Approval of Use of Facility
